# n1 - The runner command and core integrity

`scripts/runner` is one executable with a subcommand table. This node ships the table, the
`status` verb, the shared context object every other verb takes, and `CoreIntegrity`, which
re-hashes the installed manifest so D11's check has one implementation that doctor also calls.

Public verbs are `step`, `status` and `answer`; `ready`, `sweep` and `rewind` work and stay out of
the skill body. Each verb's branch requires its own module lazily, so a verb whose module has not
landed yet cannot break the suite for the verbs that have.

`RunnerCore.context(intent_dir:)` resolves, once, the things every verb needs: the intent id and
slug, the store, the plastic home, the session that holds `delivery.lock`, the intent worktree
path and branch, and the parsed graph. It returns a struct with an `errors` array and never
raises across its boundary.

## n1 failure-mode matrix
| Row | Operation | Failure mode | Test |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1.1 | Route a known verb to its module | A verb silently no-ops and the loop appears to run while nothing happens | `runner_cli_test#test_known_verb_routes_to_module` |
| 1.2 | Refuse an unknown verb | A typo runs the nearest verb, so `swep` sweeps nothing and the caller believes it swept | `runner_cli_test#test_unknown_verb_exits_2_with_usage` |
| 1.3 | Refuse a path that is not an intent directory | The runner operates on a random directory and writes a ledger into it | `runner_cli_test#test_non_intent_dir_exits_2` |
| 1.4 | Keep `rewind` out of the public usage text | The skill body publishes a verb that resets a branch before anything has measured a run | `runner_cli_test#test_usage_lists_three_public_verbs_only` |
| 1.5 | Keep `ready`, `sweep` and `rewind` callable | An internal verb that cannot be called leaves `step` with no way to compose them and no way to test them alone | `runner_cli_test#test_internal_verbs_are_callable` |
| 1.6 | Load a verb's module lazily | One missing module takes down every verb, so a partially delivered runner has no working `status` | `runner_cli_test#test_missing_module_fails_only_its_own_verb` |
| 1.7 | Resolve the intent context from disk | A wrong intent id or slug sends the worktree, the packet and the lease to another intent's paths | `runner_cli_test#test_context_resolves_id_slug_store_home` |
| 1.8 | Resolve the owning session for `delivery.lock` | The runner writes `running` under a session that does not hold the lock and the transition is refused every time | `runner_cli_test#test_context_resolves_owning_session` |
| 1.9 | Survive a missing or malformed `graph.md` in the context | The context raises and every verb dies before printing why | `runner_cli_test#test_context_reports_graph_error_without_raising` |
| 1.10 | `status` prints ready, running, blocked and the last transition per node | The operator cannot see what the loop is waiting on and re-dispatches by guess | `runner_cli_test#test_status_prints_per_node_state` |
| 1.11 | `status` writes nothing | A read-only verb appends a ledger line and inflates the attempt count | `runner_cli_test#test_status_leaves_savepoint_byte_identical` |
| 1.12 | `status` on an intent with no ledger lines | The verb raises on an empty file instead of reporting eight planned nodes | `runner_cli_test#test_status_on_empty_ledger` |
| 1.13 | Re-hash every file the manifest lists | A tampered or stale engine file runs and the runner's refusals are the refusals of code nobody reviewed | `core_integrity_test#test_drifted_file_is_reported` |
| 1.14 | Report a manifest-listed file that is gone | A deleted engine file reads as clean because only mismatches are compared | `core_integrity_test#test_missing_file_is_reported` |
| 1.15 | Handle a missing manifest | The check raises and the runner cannot start on a store whose install predates manifests | `core_integrity_test#test_absent_manifest_returns_named_reason` |
| 1.16 | Handle an unreadable or non-JSON manifest | A truncated manifest raises `JSON::ParserError` out of the integrity check and kills the step | `core_integrity_test#test_corrupt_manifest_returns_named_reason` |
| 1.17 | Report clean when every hash matches | A clean core reports drift and every step is blocked | `core_integrity_test#test_clean_manifest_reports_ok` |
| 1.18 | Re-render `graph.md` `## Status` after a transition (D28, fold of major 14) | `GraphFile.write_status` has no production caller at all, so the table the graph calls rendered reads `planned` after a full run | `runner_cli_test#test_render_status_rewrites_graph_status_table` |
| 1.19 | Render status for every declared node, including ones with no ledger line | A node with no line is dropped from the table and the graph understates the work | `runner_cli_test#test_render_status_covers_every_declared_node` |
| 1.20 | Survive a `graph.md` with no `## Status` section | The re-render raises and every transition the runner writes dies after the ledger line lands | `runner_cli_test#test_render_status_creates_missing_section` |
| 1.21 | Register `scripts/runner`, `runner_core.rb` and `core_integrity.rb` in `core_files` (D25, fold of blocker 7) | `install_sync_test` goes red the moment `scripts/runner` requires a lib the list does not carry, and stays red for every later node | `install_sync_test#test_core_files_match_disk` |
| 1.22 | Report `complete` only when every declared node is terminal (D21, fold of blocker 2) | An empty ready set caused by blockers reads as a finished intent and the run stops with work outstanding | `runner_cli_test#test_status_reports_stalled_not_complete_when_blocked` |
| 1.23 | Print each unfinished node's blockers when stalled | The operator is told the run stalled and not what it stalled on | `runner_cli_test#test_status_prints_blockers_when_stalled` |

## Steps
1. Red: the matrix's tests above, committed before any code.
2. Write `scripts/runner`, `RunnerCore` and `CoreIntegrity`.
3. Green, then the whole suite at its baseline.
